antiPollutionRules.description: Parser output must become ParserCandidate records before it can become member-selectable items or calculation rules.
Every member-selectable item must retain a source evidence asset and OCR observation pointer.

Discounts, taxes, service fees, deposits, prepayments, thresholds, receipt totals, tendered payments, points, and context-only numbers route to CalculationRule, AuditAnchor, Metadata, or ForbiddenLeak.
Rooms open to members after parser candidates reach an accepted or rejected review decision.
Pasted text can assist OCR review; primary evidence remains the uploaded image or explicitly labeled text-only fixture.
Member-facing options must originate from host-provided ServiceBlueprint options or reviewed evidence candidates.
Details absent from sparse DM, menu, price-list, booking-form, or receipt evidence route to ReceiverRequiredField or ReviewGate.
Taxes, service fees, deposits, prepayments, thresholds, tiered discounts, shipping splits, and headcount-dependent formulas cannot become member-selectable line items before host review.
Member-visible items carrying blocking ReviewGate entries cannot be released until the host resolves or removes them.
Guardrail memory stores reusable negative patterns such as phone/date/deposit-as-price mistakes, never corrected answers, raw identifiers, or final prices.
Forbidden leaks, non-currency member prices, and unresolved formulas cannot be released by plain accept; the host must edit or remove the candidate.
Candidate and oracle numbers must be normalized by stripping currency signs, separators, and non-numeric characters before forbidden-number matching.
Address numbers, tax identifiers, business numbers, contact numbers, dates, and time ranges are forbidden context numbers and must route to structural review instead of member-visible prices.
